title: pulls.jsonl row (one context request or escalation decision)
description: One row per context request a verifier made in .dabbler/runs/<set>/s<N>/pulls.jsonl. Written only by the CLI (ai_router.verify). An in-domain request is served mechanically and recorded with decider 'scope'; an out-of-domain escalation is recorded pending and decided by the orchestrating engine, whose resolved identity is the decider. There is no wildcard request and no silent widening: every request, refusal, and grant is a row. A row that fails this schema on read is a refusal, never a skip.

kind.description: 'request' names a path the scope already listed (in-domain); 'escalation' names one outside the domain.

outcome.description: 'served' is the mechanical in-domain answer; 'pending' is an escalation awaiting the orchestrating engine; 'granted'/'refused' are decisions. A refused escalation never licenses abstention.

decider.description: 'scope' when the machine served or refused it mechanically; the resolved orchestrator identity when the engine decided it.
